name: daily-stock-analysis-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is daily_stock_analysis (DSA), a Python stock-analysis application: it
analyses stocks with LLMs and market-data providers, stores analysis history, decision signals and
backtest results in a SQLite database through SQLAlchemy, and serves them through a FastAPI web API.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the backtesting and outcome-evaluation subsystem of daily_stock_analysis: src/core/backtest_engine.py, src/core/skill_opinion_outcome_evaluator.py, src/core/trading_calendar.py, every module under src/repositories/, src/schemas/ and api/v1/schemas/, the service modules src/services/backtest_service.py, src/services/decision_profile_policy.py, every src/services/decision_signal_*.py module, every src/services/skill_opinion_*.py module, src/services/stock_daily_start_resolver.py and src/services/stock_daily_window_resolver.py, the API endpoint modules api/v1/endpoints/backtest.py and api/v1/endpoints/decision_signals.py and the agent tool module src/agent/tools/backtest_tools.py, together with the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is the module, class and
function docstrings of the in-scope modules
